_changes: 2026-10-07: allow entries in rules.json / rules-mine.json now stop rewrites as well as listing (whole-file entries cover the whole file for their kinds), and logo or brand colours go to the judgement list. Whole-file allows on six NewUIAdmin2 pages and both StylingPanel files cut NewUIAdmin2 swaps 1571 to 857 and StylingPanel 24 to 10; the AdminHeader logo is no longer rewritten (AdminGroups 160 to 158, mismatches 3 to 1). Those lines now count as judgement.
